concept_uz: Sonlar chiziqchalar orasidagi yerni talab qiladi: «Ikki bilan uch orasidan bir yarim sotix bering!» Qirol oraliqni ikkiga, yana ikkiga boʻladi — yer hech qachon tugamaydi. Keyin sonlar qirolni ayblaydi, u kechirim soʻrab, hammaga «÷» oʻyinchogʻini ham beradi.

facts.claim: har qanday ikki son orasida yana bir son bor

style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm golden light, soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round golden ring-shaped king: a smooth, thick, upright gold ring like a donut standing on its edge, with big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast empty golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on a vast golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty golden plain under a huge sky, a warm sun low on the right horizon and a pale smiling moon with a gentle old woman's face on the left side of the sky, soft morning light, a faint straight line on the ground running from left to right through the centre. No characters.

Vertical 9:16. The king's long wooden staff lying flat on the golden plain from left to right, with evenly spaced carved notches along it, the middle notch glowing gold. Low camera angle along the staff, morning light, no characters.

Turn this notched staff into a lively bazaar street on the golden plain: small colourful market stalls set up in the gaps between the notches, and a long queue of small number-characters holding paper petitions. Vertical 9:16.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A lively, fast-talking bazaar broker character: round, cheerful, an embroidered doppi cap, a small notebook and pencil, waving one hand. A busy market street on a golden plain behind him, front view, centred.

scenes.prompt: A small character at the front of the queue waves its petition at the camera and says in Uzbek with an excited, high young voice: "Hazratim, ikki bilan uch orasidan bir yarim sotix bering!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Hazratim, ikki bilan uch orasidan bir yarim sotix bering!

scenes.prompt: The ring-king kneels by the staff, peers at the empty gap between two notches, and carves a new glowing notch exactly halfway. He says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Bu — ikki butun ikkidan bir." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The new character at the halfway notch immediately complains it is squeezed; the king carves another notch halfway again, and again, the notches getting finer and finer. He scratches his head and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Yana o'rtasi bor ekan…" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The broker runs through the crowded bazaar waving his notebook and says in Uzbek with a fast, hoarse bazaar-broker man's voice: "Yer tugamaydi, aka, tugamaydi! Qancha bo'lsangiz ham, o'rtasi bor!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Yer tugamaydi, aka, tugamaydi! Qancha boʻlsangiz ham, oʻrtasi bor!

scenes.prompt: A group of number-characters marches up to the king, the two twins nervously at the side. Their leader points at the king and says in Uzbek with an excited, high young voice: "Egizaklar quchoqlashsa, doim siz paydo bo'lasiz — bizdan foydalanyapsiz!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Egizaklar quchoqlashsa, doim siz paydo boʻlasiz — bizdan foydalanyapsiz!

scenes.prompt: The ring-king, hurt, puts his hand on his heart and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Men buni atayin qilmayman. Bu qoida. Lekin… kechirasiz." The crowd falls quiet. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Men buni atayin qilmayman. Bu qoida. Lekin… kechirasiz.

scenes.prompt: The king opens the old wooden chest and hands out glowing toys to everybody; he gives the bar-with-two-dots toy last, hesitantly, and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Faqat bitta shart: hech kim meni bo'lish ostiga qo'ymasin!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Faqat bitta shart: hech kim meni boʻlish ostiga qoʻymasin!

scenes.prompt: Characters gleefully play with the bar-with-two-dots toy; when they touch each other with it, strange small glowing fragments split off and float in the air. Everyone stops and stares. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a warm storyteller's male voice: "Davomi — powerty.uz da." No subtitles, no on-screen text.
